contractSummary: Deliver one stable Cloudflare Pages preview through same-repository pull requests, enforce local and CI quality gates, keep credentials secret, exclude private photos, and leave production manual.
task: Review the complete sanitized feature change and delivery evidence before finalizing the draft pull request and test deployment.
sanitizedDiff: The feature adds a pull-request and manual-dispatch GitHub Actions workflow, static workflow validation, Cloudflare preview specifications, TC Flow review and recovery artifacts, and one CI repair that selects npm and pins Wrangler 4.115.0. External changes are limited to a dedicated preview Pages project, GitHub Secrets and Variable, draft pull request #1, and preview Actions runs. No production trigger, merge, custom domain, private photo, token value, account identifier, or personal data is included.
evidence: The frozen contract and three task specifications match the implemented preview-only scope.
All three independent task reviews passed with no P0 and no reviewer degradation.
Feature QA passed all 5 acceptance criteria after static validation, 8 unit tests, type checking, production build, GitHub Actions, and browser verification.
The initial CI failure was traced to the deployment action's temporary Wrangler install under pnpm policy; the repair is enforced by a failing-then-passing static validator.
GitHub Actions run 30517588778 passed every step and deployed the tested source commit.
The stable preview showed the expected application identity and navigation after the successful run.
The pull request remains Draft and production remains manual-pending.
The working tree contains only the feature implementation, its specifications, review evidence, QA evidence, and recovery memory.
